WoW: Forever

Priest

Priest is a cloth-wearing caster with two healing specialisations and one ranged damage specialisation. Before you pick a spec, know that Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. is talent-only, as it was in Classic. The client gives it with a Shadow talent point rather than a trainer, gated on 10 points in that tree and on level 20. A Holy or Discipline Priest does not have it in practice.

WoW: Forever · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Written for levelling, 1 to 60. Forever's beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Priest build has been tested. Blizzard published its own Priest Class Deep Dive on September 30, 2026: a wide pass across baseline abilities, every racial spell and all three talent trees. This page follows Blizzard's post over the three guide sites wherever they disagree. Ability training levels below are read from the client. Blizzard's own caveat: "class abilities and talents may continue to evolve throughout the beta test and are subject to additional changes."

Once shielded, the target cannot be shielded again for 15 sec. absorbs while your wand does the killingMana efficiency and prevention rather than repair
HolyHealerBinding HealBinding HealTalent · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost155 ManaRange40 yd rangeHeals a friendly target and the caster for 247. Low threat. at 25 is a 1.5-second cast on no cooldown that heals your target and youPublished as "great all-rounders… very beginner-friendly"
ShadowRanged DPSMind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. at 20: one talent point, and it grants all six of the spell's ranksSpirit TapSpirit TapTalentCastInstant is the mana economy, and only your own killing blows trigger it

The published advice for soloing is to level with Shadow talents and respec to heal. The Discipline and Holy guides both say it in the same words: "it is a better idea to primarily use Shadow talents until you're able to get into group content." The reason is the Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%. gate above: no published build for either healing spec reaches it, so a Priest without it has SmiteSmiteLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost20 ManaRange30 yd rangeSmite an enemy for 15 Holy damage., Mind BlastMind BlastLevel 10 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 9Cast1.5 sec castCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the target for 39 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat. and a wand.

The published ratings sit on the three spec pages, each alongside the caveat that the levelling number measures solo kill speed and nothing else.

This is not a permanent commitment. Respeccing to Holy or Discipline once you want to heal dungeons is the normal path, and Dual Specialization becomes available at level 40, so from there you carry both. Below 40 it is a trainer visit. In the beta the price is 1 silver if you have not changed talents recently; a second reset costs much more and drops back to 1 silver an hour later. Blizzard calls that price "temporary for the Beta only."

Is Priest for you?

Play Priest if you want to be the person keeping everyone alive, and you are happy watching health bars rather than the fight.

Strengths

  • A shield that prevents damage rather than repairing it, and it can now overwrite itself on a target without Weakened Soul
  • Fear WardFear WardLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration180 secWards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 180 sec. is baseline for every race from level 20, so no race is locked out of it
  • Dual Specialization at level 40 carries a damage spec and a healing spec at once

Weaknesses

  • The published headings for both healing specs: "Struggles To Solo Level" and "Zero AoE and Lackluster Damage"
  • "The main reason you'll die while playing as a Priest is running out of mana while still fighting against a healthy foe"
  • Desperate PrayerDesperate PrayerLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownInstantly heals the caster for 149. is Dwarf-only now, so most Priests have no instant self-heal at all

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? Yes, a damage-over-time, a nuke, then your wand.

Is it forgiving? Not solo. Cloth armour, and the published warning is running out of mana mid-fight.

What carries you while levelling? SmiteSmiteLevel 1 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 8Cast1.5 sec castCost20 ManaRange30 yd rangeSmite an enemy for 15 Holy damage., Mind BlastMind BlastLevel 10 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 9Cast1.5 sec castCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown8 sec cooldownBlasts the target for 39 Shadow damage, but causes a high amount of threat. and a wand until Mind FlayMind FlayLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost45 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration3 secAssault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%., which needs 10 points in Shadow. None of it is fast on your own. Each spec page carries the published ratings.

Does it need a group? It does not require one, but the published advice for both healing specs is Shadow talents until you can heal in groups.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP, and specifically the ones that break crowd control: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead, fear, sleep and charm), Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome, roots and snares) and StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. (Dwarf, bleeds, poisons and disease). A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

You used to pick Dwarf for Fear WardFear WardLevel 20 · Spell · HolyCastInstantCost100 ManaRange30 yd rangeCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration180 secWards the friendly target against Fear. The next Fear effect used against the target will fail, using up the ward. Lasts 180 sec.. Fear Ward is now baseline for everyone, so that reason is gone.

Alliance: Gnome. Its two Priest racials are new this patch: Confounding FlashConfounding FlashTalentCast0.5 sec castCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 sec and Contingency PlanContingency PlanTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRange50000 yd rangeDuration15 sec, the only area confuse and the only automatic below-35% absorb in the table below. Dwarf's case is a self-heal instead. Desperate PrayerDesperate PrayerLevel 10 · Spell · Holy · Rank 1 of 7CastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownInstantly heals the caster for 149. at level 10 is a full instant self-heal, and nothing else on Alliance has one that early. Dwarf also picks up a new level-20 racial, ChastiseChastiseTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost50 ManaRange20 yd rangeCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration2 secChastise the target, causing 46 Holy damage and immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat. (damages and immobilises a Humanoid target for 2 seconds, instant, 2-minute cooldown).

Horde: Undead, for Touch of WeaknessTouch of WeaknessTalent · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaDuration600 secThe next melee attack against the caster will cause 8 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 43 for 120 sec. and Dark SacrificeDark SacrificeTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRange100 yd range. Blizzard's class post settles a three-way disagreement among the sites. Icy Veins named Undead's second Priest racial Touch of the GraveTouch of the GraveTalentCastInstantYour spells and attacks have a 10% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.; ClassicWoW.gg named it Touch of WeaknessTouch of WeaknessTalent · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaDuration600 secThe next melee attack against the caster will cause 8 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 43 for 120 sec.; Wowhead's class-quest table marked the level-20 Undead Priest spell "coming soon" rather than pick a side. Blizzard's answer: Undead keeps Touch of WeaknessTouch of WeaknessTalent · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaDuration600 secThe next melee attack against the caster will cause 8 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by 43 for 120 sec. unchanged and gains a new level-20 spell, Dark SacrificeDark SacrificeTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRange100 yd range. That one cannibalises your own health to gain Mana over time, with the Mana gain increased by Spirit. FadeFadeLevel 8 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost40 ManaCooldown30 sec cooldownDuration10 secFade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec.'s doubled threat reduction is not part of the case for Undead, because Blizzard lists it under Baseline Abilities, so every Priest of every race has it. Every Undead character has the general-race ability CannibalizeCannibalizeTalentCastInstantRangeMeleeCooldown120 sec cooldownWhen activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect., Priest or not, and it is a separate thing from the two spells above. It cannot be used while the caster is immune to Physical damage. A datamined ten-minute cooldown circulated for Dark SacrificeDark SacrificeTalent · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantRange100 yd range, which would make it an emergency mana button rather than a repeatable trade. The client carries no cooldown on it and no tooltip at all, and Blizzard's post states no cooldown either, so treat the ten minutes as unconfirmed.

Quality of life

  • The wand is the levelling mechanic. Wand skill is default, so a wand works the moment you loot one, and Wand SpecializationWand SpecializationTalentCastInstantIncreases your damage with Wands by 25%. is now two points instead of five. Get one early.
  • Re-drag your action bars, or use macros. Before level 20 nearly every even level brings a new rank of Smite, Mind Blast, Shadow Word: Pain or Power Word: Shield, and the bars do not update themselves. A /cast Spell Name macro always fires the highest rank you know.
  • Tailoring and Enchanting. The good Forever crafted pieces are bind-on-pickup, so you can only make them for yourself.

At level 60

Unknown. No source publishes a Priest build past 30, and much of the detailed Priest material circulating comes from a pre-beta demo build that nobody has re-verified. Raids open December 9.

Sources
